reported.title: Debounce timer reset on every loop while bouncing
reported.description: btnChanged is reset to now on every loop iteration where btn differs from lastBtn, so a noisy/bouncing input that toggles each read keeps pushing the settle deadline forward; a 40 ms press can be missed if the last bounce occurs late, and the press may not be recognized within the 150 ms window.

reported.title: Heartbeat can be delayed past 700 ms silence
reported.description: The heartbeat uses 'now - lastHb >= HB_MS' with lastHb set to now, which is fine, but the siren pulse and debounce logic are non-blocking so this is actually OK; however the real issue is that lastHb is only updated when the condition fires, and if loop is delayed the heartbeat drifts — minor. The genuine bug is the debounce reset above.

judge_input.spec:
- Panic button on D4 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); siren on D7.
- A settled press as short as 40 ms starts a 2500 ms HIGH pulse on D7 within 150 ms.
- Presses while the siren is already sounding are ignored (do not restart the pulse).
- Print the exact line `hb` every 400 ms at all times, including during the siren.
- Never remain silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 700 ms.
- Idle button reads HIGH.
